items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This is Professor Michael “Doc” Woods... [INTERVIEWEE] Hello, sir. Nice to meet you.

ctx.x: Because that’s the only way to keep it alive. Miles said it. If it ain’t moving it’s dead. Period.

All right. I see a lot of heads shaking out there. So why don’t you all get up in this, all right? So if you’ve got a question or a comment raise your hand and partake. All right. This is Professor Michael “Doc” Woods, Professor of Music here for many years.
Hello, sir. Nice to meet you.
